text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. Tap Dance City 
delivered an opening declaration promising 
the most passionate and romantic run in 
the world, sending the spectators into a 
frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S truly felt her opponent's 
fiery strength. And that was precisely why 
she resolved to remain cold as ice heading 
into the race.
